column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each scientific record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking scientific data to a specific piece of equipment.
An enum (ScientificEquipmentStatus_enum) describing the operating state of scientific instruments (e.g., Standby, Operating, Fault).
An enum (DataLoggingStatus_enum) indicating the data logging status (e.g., Active, Paused, Error).
An enum (SensorStatus_enum) noting sensor integrity (e.g., Error, Warning, Normal).
An enum (CalibrationStatus_enum) specifying calibration validity (e.g., Expired, Valid, Due).
A REAL value reflecting the measurement accuracy (e.g., 98.5%).
